description.value: Whenever you use an action with the traversal trait, if you're piloting a hoverboard, you can substitute a Drive action in place of the Stride action. In addition, while piloting a hoverboard, you can [[/act leap]], using your hoverboard's speed in place of your own, and you can roll a Piloting check in place of an Athletics check when you [[/act high-jump]] or [[/act long-jump]]. If you critically fail and would fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone], you're also thrown off your hoverboard.
